circuit_edit_figure.modifications: Rasterized the complete original vector figure. No crop, relabeling, numerical extraction, or changes to bars/axes/legend. In this presentation the white background is shown in the page’s paper color.
circuit_edit_figure.data_status: The author source archive includes the vector plot but no underlying numerical data or plotting script. No precise numerical circuit-success values are claimed or inferred from raster pixels.
circuit_edit_figure.success_criteria: The target recipient outranks the unchanged subject for IOI. The target token outranks the source token for gendered pronouns and greater-than.
circuit_edit_figure.material_limitation: The comparison uses different models and edit rules, with layers chosen per task and model.
